cases.study_information: Example20 reports cytokine induction in Vδ1/tumor cocultures using A375 orA431, withEC50pM andSD. Only a subset is shown in this CSV; MCP1 A431 is not reported and remainsblank. The source reports noIL17A,IL10,IL1β increase>1.2fold under the tested conditions, while several other cytokines have measurable responses. A separate healthy-cell-sparing assay in Example19 uses6.6nMADT1-4-2 and assesses monocyte cytotoxicity/apoptosis; it does not measure clinical cytokine syndrome.

dependence_note: Shared sources must be interpreted at the study-family level.
title: Interpreting conditional cytokine responses without overclaiming safety
